title: INFECTION CONTROL
knowledge: Discuss the use of universal precautions.
Describe the assessment, screening and type of Isolation required for various Infectious Disease e.g. MRSA.
Discuss measures to prevent needle stick injuries and verbalize reporting procedure.
State at least three (3) Isolation techniques, one indication for each, as well as traffic control requirements for each.
Describe the use of HEPA Filter and when to apply it (if available).
Explain how to monitor the negative pressure Isolation Rooms.
Explain how to decontaminate Isolation equipment following an Infectious Disease in area of practice.
Identify the chemical disinfectants used in the hospital.
Discuss equipment storage and containment of used equipment for disposal and decontamination related to infection control.
skills: Demonstrate the measures to prevent needle stick injuries and reporting mechanism and document.
Demonstrate use of Hepa Filter and when to apply it.
Complete the monitoring process for negative pressure Isolation rooms.
Demonstrate how to decontaminate equipment used following exposure to an infectious disease.
Demonstrate the labeling of specimen and complete the documentation of a patient with an Infectious disease.
attitude: Accept infectious patient assignment professionally and treats patient and family with dignity and respect
Exhibit appropriate level of concern to eliminate, prevent and control the occurrence and/or exposure to infection and/or Infectious disease
Show a belief that the environment created in the ward/ department can impact and quality of care and emotional response of a patient with an infectious disease
Show commitment towards improving self-awareness amongst colleagues and how this helps to improve the working environment for a staff as well as patients etc.

Demonstrate ability to organize and facilitate a reflection session in and on practice after any safety issue is highlighted when caring for patients with an infection and/or infectious disease and activate findings to improve future practice and response
Display proactivity towards safety in the work environment and minimizing the transmission of hospital acquired infectious disease for patients and staff.
